thread:
elaine: Hey team, customer (jv corp) hitting intermittent 403s on SSO login since their IdP rotation; they say it only happens for some users and regions. Here's the RelayState they've been using: https://app.customer-jv.com/_saml/acs

matt_r: Did they change ACS hostname recently? 403 suggests recipient mismatch or cert verify fail.

customer-jv: We rotated cert yesterday and swapped metadata. Some log lines show "InvalidRecipient" and "Signature verification failed". It affects ~15% of logins.

support-bot: Incident created: INC-5482. Attached SAMLResponse sample (redacted) and metadata URL: https://idp.customer-jv.com/metadata.xml

nate: Can you paste the exact SP-ACS URL from our logs (including trailing slash)?

elaine: Logs: sp_receiver= https://app.customer-jv.com/sso/saml/acs (no trailing slash)

matt_r: Ok. IdP metadata has two AssertionConsumerService entries: one for https://app.customer-jv.com/sso/saml/acs and another for https://app.customer-jv.com/sso/saml/acs/alt-host. Our SP verifies recipient strict matching to first ACS entry. If IdP sometimes sends the alt-host in SAMLResponse it will 403.

oncall-sre: Also noticed the signing cert in their metadata has a different SHA1 thumbprint to the key actually used in the signed Assertion: metadata shows SHA1: A1:B2:C3:4D:5E:6F:70:81:92:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:11:22:33:44, Assertion verifies with SHA1: A1:B2:C3:4D:5E:6F:70:81:92:AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF:10:22:33:44 (off by a byte). Could be whitespace or encoding issue during IdP export.

matt_r: Repro steps for us:
1) curl -s 'https://idp.customer-jv.com/sso/redirect?sp=https%3A%2F%2Fapp.customer-jv.com%2Fsso%2Fsaml%2Facs' -o /tmp/resp.html
2) Extract SAMLResponse and decode base64: 
```
echo 'BASE64...' | base64 -d | xmllint --format -
```
3) Check Recipient attribute in SubjectConfirmationData and Signature's KeyInfo certificate.

elaine: Workaround for customer: ask IdP to prefer canonical ACS URL (remove alt-host) or add the alt-host as explicit ACS in our SP config. I can push a temporary SP acceptor for that tenant to allow both paths (need approval).

oncall-sre: Quick mitigation: force metadata refresh on proxy cache and reload our IdP-truststore for tenant jv-corp: `adminctl tenants refresh-metadata jv-corp --force` (will cause a few seconds of latency). Also clear our CDN edge cache for their domain.

matt_r: Longer term: add relaxed recipient matching with a strict allowlist per tenant and normalize trailing slashes on ACS field. Also add a metadata-thumbprint normalization to ignore benign whitespace differences.

customer-jv: We'll roll back to old metadata for now and schedule a proper rotation with you. Thanks for the quick triage :v: 

elaine: I'll open a PR for the temporary acceptor and coordinate the rollback window. Adding notes to INC-5482.
